newsitem.title: USA: Seitel cuts interest in Energy Research.
newsitem.headline: Seitel cuts interest in Energy Research.

text.p: Seitel Inc, a developer of seismic technology, said it has cut its equity interest to 19 percent from 50 percent in Energy Research International, a holding company which owns two marine-seismic companies.

The company said it sold 31 percent back to ERI because owning more than a minority interest did not prove to accurately reflect that business in Seitel's financials, due to intricacies of tax and accounting requirements.
Seitel said terms of the origial acquisition of the 50 percent stake, which was purchased last July, were not disclosed, nor were the terms of the equity saleback.
Seitel also said that all three of its seismic recording crews are fully booked until July, including its newest third crew, with new three dimensional state-of-the-art technology.

The new crew features an advanced Opseis Eagle 1,850 channel, radio-telmetry system, manufactured by Sercel. It is similar to Seitel's two existing systems/crews and it increases the company's in-house, onshore seismic recording capability by 50 percent, Seitel said.
